summary: Revalidated SafeTap AI backend and mobile web preview after the authorization fix. All 7 backend regression tests and all requested role/login/scan/dashboard/logout UI flows passed.
action_items: Align frontend environment variable usage with the required EXPO_BACKEND_URL contract, or document EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL as the deployment standard.
Add testID attributes to login role controls, email/password inputs, login, and scan controls for robust native/UI automation.
critical_code_review_comments: Frontend currently constructs API URL from expo extra backendUrl or EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL rather than EXPO_BACKEND_URL; preview is functional because the public variable is configured.
Threat feed matching and AI explanation are MOCKED deterministic fallback behavior because no live feed URL/key or live AI call is enabled.
seed_data_creation: Created one additional scan case through the public scan API during UI/API verification; no users or brands created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL tested at https://threat-verify-7.preview.emergentagent.com with 375x667 viewport. Victim scan secure-paypal-check.com displayed risk result, factors, known/reported phishing, and Recently Reported Threat. Investigator and Admin dashboards loaded. Unauthenticated protected endpoints returned 403 and authorized role tokens returned 200.
rca_of_issue: Prior authorization issue is resolved: overview and cases routes validate in-memory demo bearer tokens and enforce expected roles; frontend passes the login token to overview calls. The regression suite was updated to load the configured preview URL from frontend/.env and to assert protected-route behavior.
